{{Color|Other|Foam}} [[Freezer]] skin |toy_type = Dart Blaster }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''NERF: The Mint Choco Freezer Dart Blaster''' is a NERF dart blaster made on the August 2022, made by Hasbro. The dart blaster is based on the {{Color|Premium|Mint Choco}} [[Freezer]]'s Level 0-3 cryogun. When you buy the dart blaster, one redeemable code is given, which used to allow you to get the {{RLinkC|8072333951|MCF}} accessory on Roblox and the {{Color|Other|Foam}} [[Freezer]] skin. The toy is recommended for ages 8+ and is not suitable for children under 3 years old. This product has been discontinued, however some stores and online retailers still have it in stock. ==Official Description== *'''From Hasbro website''' *:This Nerf MicroShots Roblox Tower Defense Simulator: The Mint Choco Freezer dart blaster takes its inspiration from the Roblox experience Tower Defense Simulator by Paradoxum Games! The blaster includes a special code that allows you to redeem an exclusive virtual item on Roblox*. *'''On Pack''' *:Strategy, teamwork, and firepower combine for some seriously fun mayhem in Paradoxum Games' Tower Defense Simulator. ==Prices & Stores== Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. Generally, it costs around $9.99-$11.99 in the US and around $5 CAD in Canada. {{ToyNavBox}}
